body: DDG really took over the Spelhouse homecoming DDG made a special appearance at Spellhouse’s homecoming concert, pulling up to show love and bring some extra energy to the night The surprise moment gave students a chance to see the rapper in person and turned the campus event into one they won’t forget anytime soon. From the crowd’s reaction to DDG joining the celebration, Spellhouse homecoming had a major guest in the building. Did you expect DDG to pull up?
